parts.text: The halogens are a group of diatomic non-metals showing a trend in colour, state and reactivity.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) In this description, what is the meaning of

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) diatomic, [1]

ms.label: 5(a)(i)
ms.text:
molecule containing 2 atoms
ALLOW: element containing 2 atoms

ms.text: (ii) whether it is solid, liquid or gas (all 3 needed)

parts.text: (d) (i) Draw a diagram to show the electronic structure of a chlorine molecule. Show only the outer electrons. [2]

ms.label: 5(d)(i)
ms.text:
8 electrons in each shell + atoms joined
no bonding electrons = 1
IGNORE: inner shell electrons if correct

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) State a use of chlorine. [1]

ms.label: 5(d)(ii)
ms.text:
(ii) water purification OR treatment/killing bacteria etc./bleaching agent (for paper)/
making refrigerants/making organic chlorine compounds (named)/making
solvents/extracting titanium/detinning scrap tinplate/making hydrochloric
acid/extraction of bromine from seawater/other suitable use
